description: Chinese tax dispute dates: administrative reconsideration within 60 days of knowing the act (tax payment disputes require paying or guaranteeing first, Tax Collection Law art. 88), lawsuit within 15 days of the reconsideration decision, direct lawsuit against penalties within 6 months, overpaid tax refund claim within 3 years of payment (art. 51); recovery periods 3/5 years or unlimited (art. 52). Weekends shift to Monday; public holidays are not included. Mainland China, as of 2026-11-21 (laws and State Taxation Administration announcements in the official regulations database). General information and estimates only; no individual tax consulting, agency or filing. The 2027 filing calendar is not yet published.
